title: DICTO: Collected Geometric Works
description:
DICTO is a geometric sculptor in Osaka. The work grows out of building with recycled PET bottles and from three open apps on one shared geometry: Kaleidohedra, Rhombiverse and Polyhedraverse.

Version 51 (12 November 2026) adds #97, Narcissus Keyed (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24005567), #98, Narcissus and Covenant (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24005929), #99, Plato's Five in the Octet, with its Version 2 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24012439), #100, The Dehn Test Picks the Lone Tilers (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24030326), #101, Held by Shape Alone (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24030328), #102, Every Site Hears the Same: the Loop Equality Is a Theorem (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24037664), and #103, The DICTO Yantra: Two Exact Solutions, with its Version 2 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24052633); the translations Quanta of Space, Volume I, in Chinese (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24030227), in Persian (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24037666), in Arabic (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24037670), The DICTOnary of Atoms in Japanese (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24028641), in Chinese (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24030229), in Persian (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24037668), in Arabic (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24037672), each its own record; it lists new versions of #39 (version 2), #43 (version 2, Theorem 4: the octahedral constant 3), #47 (version 3), #74 (version 2, the Loop Equality now a theorem), #92 (version 3), #93 (version 2), #94 (version 2) and #95 (version 4), and of the books HexOct: The Hexagonality Law (versions 8 to 11, Part V on Narcissus), Alicia in Wonderland (version 4, Chapter 9 The Silent Queens), The Golden Ladder (versions 2 to 6, the whole book, now from Plato to the Eighth Dimension), Quanta of Space (version 2.2), its Japanese translation (version 2), The DICTOnary of Atoms (version 1.3) and The DICTO Concordance (version 2.1), and the DICTO Solids data set line moves to version 8 (91 solids, D1–D134).

Version 50 (5 November 2026) adds #86, The HexOct Family (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23896076), #87, DICTO Vacuus Solids (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23896015), #88, Every Platonic Solid Has Exactly Two Golden Cuts, with its Version 2 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23896439), #89, All Five Golden Pairs Are Slices of Four-Dimensional Solids (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23917931), #90, Golden on the Octahedron, Silver on the Cube (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23931136), #91, Four-Dimensional Solids Whose Every Cell Is a Golden Cut (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23931389), #92, Aristotle's Pyramid in Layers, with its Version 2 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23931608), #93, One Double Pyramid, Two Splits (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23933666), #94, The Silent Golden Station (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23934349), #95, Pentagons for the Kites, with its Version 3 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23968270), and #96, Reading the Voids, with its Version 3 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23968272); the books The DICTOnary of Atoms: Quanta of Space II, version 1.1 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23966395), the Japanese translation of Quanta of Space, Volume I (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23966535), The Golden Ladder, version 1, chapters 1 and 2 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23966554), and DICTONIC Bonds: from the Octet to the Rule of Halves (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23898027), and The DICTO Concordance (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23934363); it lists Quanta of Space version 2, now in two volumes, and new versions of #31 (version 5), #36 (version 4), #37 (version 5), #37a (version 5), #44 (versions 3 and 4) and #78 (version 3, the core's cut corrected).

Version 49 (2 November 2026) adds #81, Core Cycles (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23846772), #83, HexOct: Knitting Crystals, with its Version 2 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23848271), #84, The Window Law (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23848832), #85, Eccentric Pieces, with its Version 3 (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23850490), and the book Star Cores: Spikes, Halos and Cycles, Cycles of Growth, Part II (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23867732); it lists HexOct: The Hexagonality Law, with the Window Law, the Rule of Halves & the Swap Rule, version 7, third edition, The Golden Cycle version 3 (Cycles of Growth, Part I) and #79 version 3, and the DICTO Solids data set line moves to version 7 (69 solids, D1–D109).

Version 48 (31 October 2026) adds #79, Star Cores of DICTO's Solids (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23822905), and #80, The Gains of DICTO's Growth Rule (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23822907), and lists Alicia in Wonderland version 3 (43 full-page plates) and HexOct: The Hexagonality Law version 6, second edition (13 full-page plates).

Version 47 (30 October 2026) adds #76, Between the Queens (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23780068), #77, Face to Face: A New Law of Aristotle's Pyramids (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23779962), and #78, The Truncated Icosahedron Star (TI Star), with its Version 2, the core's own cycle (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23782577); it lists the new versions of the four books, HexOct under its new title HexOct: The Hexagonality Law, Alicia in Wonderland version 2, The Golden Cycle version 2 and Quanta of Space version 1.4; Shadow-17 of #62 is now named Kagemusha; and the DICTO Solids data set line moves to version 6 (65 solids, D1–D105).

Version 46 (29 October 2026) adds #75, HexOct: Two Tiles for Every Stacking (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23737639), and three books: The Golden Cycle: Icosahedral Shells, from the Chain of Karma to the Gnomon (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23752452), Alicia in Wonderland: The Red & White Queens (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23753305) and Quanta of Space: A Manifesto (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23754454); the book The Laws of Stacking is now HexOct: The Laws of Stacking, second edition. Version 45 (28 October 2026) adds the book The Laws of Stacking: Halves, Swaps and Hexagonality, from Geometry to Real Materials (DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23731359). Version 44 (28 October 2026) adds #74, Spin Ice and Kagome Magnets on Every Stacking. Version 43 (28 October 2026) adds #73, The Hexagonality Law in Real Materials V: Ice, Diamond and Nanowires. Version 42 (28 October 2026) adds #72, The Hexagonality Law in Real Materials IV: Oxides. Version 41 (28 October 2026) adds #71, The Hexagonality Law in Real Materials III: Alloys and Hydrogen. Version 40 (28 October 2026) adds #70, The Hexagonality Law in Real Materials II: Entropy and Pressure, and lists Version 2 of #69. Version 39 (28 October 2026) adds #69, The Hexagonality Law and the Fibonacci Stacking, and gives DICTO's ORCID iD 0009-0001-2620-2036. Version 38 (28 October 2026) adds #68, Real Polytypes and the Hexagonality Law. Version 37 (28 October 2026) adds #67, Random Stackings and Stacking Faults: the Hexagonality Law at Work. Version 36 (28 October 2026) adds #66, The Focus: One Study of Space in Pieces, and the Hexagonality Law, and lists Version 3 of #63 and Version 2 of #65 (direction vectors, exact checks, tables of every slice pattern, and Alicia Boole Stott's 1900 paper, now read). Version 35 (28 October 2026) adds #64, The Swap Rule in Crystals: Rock Salt, Cadmium Iodide, Zinc Blende and the Laves Phases on Every Stacking, and #65, The Red Queen 120-cell: Aristotle's five pyramids as the cores of the regular four-dimensional solids; section 3 of the introduction, until now Aristotle's mistake, is now Aristotle's pyramids (Aristotle wrote “the pyramid” without saying which; only the later reading of it as the regular tetrahedron fails, and #44, #63 and #65 carry his claim into four dimensions); section 5 gains a note on the rule of halves and the Swap Rule. Version 34 (28 October 2026) lists Version 2 of #63, The White Queen 600-cell (the fifteen Cleo shells read the same backwards), and Version 4 of the data set DICTO Solids: Exact Geometry (Ganesha D84, Humpty Dumpty D85, Shadow-17 D86). Version 33 (27 October 2026) added #62, Shadows of the Fourth Dimension, and #63, The White Queen 600-cell, and a paragraph on the history of the shells (Aristotle, Bradwardine, Kepler, the 600-cell). Version 32 (27 October 2026) added #61, The Swap Rule: Ganesha, the Janus Tetrahedra of Squashed Stackings, and the Border at True Close Packing. Version 31 (27 October 2026) added #60, DICTO Janus c/h Pyrochlore; #59 is now at version 2 (a corrected volume). Version 28 (25 October 2026) adds #56, Sonsam and Lahdeli: the Delian Bond on the Twinned Octet, with Ian Dury, Blockhead and Keyed Switch Points, and lists the solids named in the Bonds papers under Atoms. Version 27 (25 October 2026) adds #54, One Turn Is a Gnomon: the Golden Cycle Step by Step, and the Polar of the Keyed Pair. Version 26 (25 October 2026) adds #55, David and Goliath: Jessen's Icosahedron and the Tetrahedron in the A15 Weight Walk. Version 25 (25 October 2026) adds #53, The Global Web of Bonds: How Bonds Hand Over Across Crystal Networks. Version 24 (25 October 2026) adds #52, The Web of Bonds: How the DICTONIC Bonds Hand Over; lists the newest papers first, with a What's new box on the first page; names the six DICTONIC SOLIDS and three DICTONIC BONDS in the introduction; and lists the DICTONIC world and the data set DICTO Solids: Exact Geometry (DICTO DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23606967). Version 23 (24 October 2026) added #50, One Move Each.
